decisions.reason: The healthcare and hospitality recruitment service is distant from the firm's announced maritime solutions direction and has only weak website presence with no quantified results, so management cannot attribute the disappointing outcome to temporary causes and will drop it.

Superyacht crew recruitment builds on the firm's established crew services and has been publicly offered for two years, so sunk costs and fit with core crewing lead management to persist despite limited visibility.

The maritime education programme has a dedicated website page and a quantified result of six partner institutions, aligning with the firm's training and expansion direction, so management will keep it.

Emissions monitoring and compliance services are close to the established offer and achieved a quantified compliance success, reinforcing the firm's environmental direction and justifying continued commitment.

The emissions compliance dashboard is a recent digital product aligned with the firm's announced digitalisation and environmental direction, so management will retain it while results are still early.

The emissions compliance cost simulation tool also fits the firm's digital environmental solutions and was launched only recently, so management is likely to keep it to justify the initial investment.
